newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures end down on slow day.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures end down on slow day.

text.p: U.S. debt futures finished pit trading mostly lower on a day of very thin activity.
Late selling was seen in reaction to remarks by U.S. Federal Reserve Board Governor Susan Phillips, traders said.

Three big dealers sold December U.S. 30-year Treasury bond futures near the close, driving the contract to an intraday low of 115-07/64 in the last half-hour of pit trading after Phillips's remarks on the economy and inflation, traders said.
In an interview with Reuters, Phillips said Friday there is good reason to believe that consumers will resume spending, leading to a good holiday season.
